{{Weapon infobox | type = pistol | level = 80 | salvage = none | rarity = legendary | uslot = Superior Sigil of Stamina | bound = account use | skin = Quip (skin); Chaos Gun (skin); Lyssa's Gaze; Chaos Gun Experiment (skin) | prefix = selectable | id = 30693 | gallery1 = Quip (skin).jpg | gallery2 = Quip footfalls.jpg | gallery2-text = Confetti footfalls. }} [[Quip]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] pistol crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|The most renowned [[thief]] in [[Kryta]] had a couple of calling cards—drove the [[Lionguard]] mad. She always left two things behind: a trail of confetti and a note that read "I can run faster than a [[centaur]]!"}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{Recipe | source = Mystic Forge | ingredient1 = 1 Chaos Gun | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Quip | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery | quantity = 1 }} == Graphics == [[Quip]] is a pistol that resembles a toy party favor. ; Aura * The user's body is surrounded by purple mist. ; Draw/Stow effects * Confetti bursts out of the user when drawn. ; Footfalls * The user leaves behind multicolored confetti. ; Skill effects * When firing Quip, colorful streamers and confetti or daisy flowers randomly burst out of the barrel. A party popper noise is also heard. * There is a chance to display a pistol "spin" animation whenever a skill is completed. * Default projectiles are replaced with streams of confetti. This effect changes the following skills: ** {{me}} [[Mesmer]]: [[Magic Bullet]] and [[Phantasmal Duelist]] ** {{en}} [[Engineer]]: [[Fragmentation Shot]], [[Poison Dart Volley]], [[Static Shot]], [[Grenade Barrage]], [[Grappling Line]] (downed skill), [[Throw Junk]] (downed skill), and the projectiles from [[Static Shot]] that bounce between enemies ** {{t}} [[Thief]]: [[Vital Shot]], [[Sneak Attack]], [[Bola Shot]], [[Repeater]], [[Shadow Strike]], [[Unload]], [[Head Shot]], [[Black Powder]], and [[Trail of Knives]] (downed skill) === Gallery === File:Drawing Quip.jpg|When first drawn. the first step towards crafting the precursor. *[[Quip II: The Perfected Pistol]] *[[Quip III: Chaos Gun]] == Trivia == * [[Scarlet Briar]] could be seen wielding this weapon in the [[Scarlet's Playhouse]] instance. * A [[Bringer's Wrapped Pistol|"gift-wrapped" version]] of this skin can be found as part of the [[Wrapped weapons]] set. * The lore segment references a piece of player chatter triggered by [[Swiftness]] being applied to a female human character, in which they will shout "I could outrun a centaur!" {{Legendary weapon nav}} [[Category:Legendary weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with unique sounds]] [[de:Knaller]] [[es:Gracia]] [[fr:Répartie]]
